message.content: {"ranked_ids": ["candidate_001", "candidate_002", "candidate_003", "candidate_004", "candidate_005", "candidate_006", "candidate_007", "candidate_008"], "explanation": "The first trace mismatch occurs at cycle 101 on o_sck, indicating a startup/clk timing issue. The llsdspi module's WAIT_FOR_STARTUP generate block controls the startup_hold signal which gates SPI clock generation and CS de-assertion. Candidates 001-004 directly modify the startup counter logic and clock toggling during startup. Candidates 005-008 add gating conditions to the startup counter increment edge detector (past_sclk/o_sclk transition), which could prevent premature startup exit if the edge detection is too sensitive. These eight candidates target the startup hold mechanism most likely to cause the early o_sck=1 mismatch."}
